dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: The trailing edge spline is defined by a major concave discontinuity (notch) at the vertical midpoint and secondary high-frequency irregularities along the margin, precluding a standard falcate curvature.

dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: The anterior margin rises at a steepness of approximately 42 degrees relative to the horizontal longitudinal axis of the dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The ratio of the fin's maximum pixel base width to its maximum vertical pixel height is approximately 1.7:1.

anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: The interior angle at the pixel coordinate where the melon slope transitions into the rostrum is measured at approximately 160 degrees.
